body: Stop answer needs no agent connection: routed by current_slot (live top-level, current session of its slot, topic present) only; alternative was reusing live_reply_slot which also requires a bound agent conn, rejected because the answer comes from the hook, not the agent.

No Stop dedup added: two identical Stops stay two answers (ingress contract two_stops_of_one_prompt_are_two_events); no double-delivery path found besides the model also calling reply, handled by the new channel instructions.
Also changed the reply tool description in reply_tool() (it said use it to answer channel messages), otherwise it contradicts the new instructions and invites double answers.

E2E drives Stop through the real `cctg hook Stop` binary but SessionStart/SessionEnd through hook::post with explicit pids; alternative (binary for SessionStart too) rejected because its lineage walk would see the QA run's own claude.exe ancestors and mark the session nested.
